name: David Montgomery
bio:
David Montgomery's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Fresh out of college with a degree in computer science, he found himself working for a small tech startup that happened to provide network infrastructure for a local racing team. The speed and precision of the pit lane, coupled with the complex data analysis required to optimize car performance, captivated him. He quickly transitioned from general IT support to specializing in motorsport systems.

At Proton by Premotion, David is responsible for maintaining and upgrading the team's entire IT infrastructure, from race day data acquisition to simulation software and communications. He's a firm believer in proactive system monitoring and preventative maintenance, ensuring the team never suffers a critical IT failure at a crucial moment. He is known for his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure, and his constant pursuit of innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge.

David's dedication extends beyond technical expertise; he is a mentor to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the IT department. He is passionate about harnessing the power of data to drive performance, and his innovative approach makes him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: David is a solidly built man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even to meetings.
Drinks an excessive amount of black coffee.
Frequently uses motorsport analogies to explain technical concepts.
